entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Lifetime of collection expressions seems to be longer than it should be in some cases #80107
  • Report error when Hot Reload attributes are applied manually #80106
  • No error is reported on `EmbeddedAttribute` with `file` accessibility #80105

PullRequests

Created

  • Allow `ToArray` optimization when resulting array can be implicitly reference-converted to the target array #80104
    Area-Compilers, Community

Merged

  • Allow Razor to get task list items for a document #80102
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Update debugger packages, move to PortableInterop IMetadataImport #80063
    Area-Interactive, Community, Next

Updated

  • wip #80075
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Runtime-async ref local hoisting #80093
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Better codegen for record's `Equals` member #79966
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Break cycle for lambda using field keyword with inferred return type #79995
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Field Keyword
  • More MS.CA.CSharp resource cleanup #80100
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • MS.CA.VB resources cleanup #80098
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Remove CompilationPair abstraction in diagnostic analyzer subsystem. #80086
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • Store client's version for open docs in LSP #80064
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Pass global properties and the binary log path via RPC #80094
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use apphost for core compiler #80026
